entities.name: GUTI reallocation procedure
entities.description: Procedure for reallocating the Globally Unique Temporary Identity (GUTI) to a UE.

entities.name: GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate GUTI reallocation.

entities.name: GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to confirm successful GUTI reallocation.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity used to identify the UE.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where the UE is registered with the network.

relations.description: GUTI reallocation procedure includes sending GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message.
GUTI reallocation procedure includes receiving GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message contains the GUTI information element.
GUTI reallocation procedure requires the UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
